title: Jackrabbit Finance
tagline: Decentralized Bond Exchange built on Filecoin Virtual Machine bringing Bonds to DeFi. http://www.jrt.finance/
description:
Jackrabbit Exchange is a decentralized bond exchange on FVM. Bonds are based on EIP 3475 on-chain storage bonds (tokenized debt obligations). The bond marketplace and exchange are managed by a third party (D/Bond Protocol-KYC) for regulatory compliance. Jackrabbit Finance provides liquidity via liquidity pools (ERC20 token pairs) to the bond marketplace while deployed on FVM. Jackrabbit also provides a cross-chain bridge (Swing API) for users to bring assets from other blockchains to stake.

http://www.jrt.finance/
how_its_made: Jackrabbit Dapp is a React.js app. The liquidity pool and bond (EIP 3475) smart contracts are in solidity. The cross-chain swap (FVM not available yet) is in Javascript via the Swing API (cross-chain bridge aggregator).The Swing API allows for assets to be bridged from other Blockchains to the platform. Bridge to FVM is not available but is coming soon. All smart contracts are deployed on the Wallaby testnet.
